description: NaCrF₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.61 Å. Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form corner-sharing CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-37°. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.86-1.95 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Cr atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Cr atoms.
